data: Hi, how may I help you?

What would you like to report? Select one or more.
1. Harness log — Export the complete agentic harness log.
2. Server log — Export the matching Formal AI server log.
3. GitHub issue — File an issue with complete context.
4. Report to Formal AI — Store the report so this instance can learn.

Which context should the GitHub issue include?
1. Both logs — Include harness and server logs; attach a trimmed preview and link the full context if too large.
2. Harness log — Include the complete harness conversation only.
3. Server log — Include the complete matching server log only.
I’ll file the report in the Formal AI GitHub repository.
